title: feat(bodyk16): on B16, nu body reverse is yes yes no no no
science: Body-diagonal counterpart to #6769's face sweep: nu body reverse vs k on B_16(0) for k=1..5 comes out yes, yes, no, no, no (432>400; 1200>1024; 1728<1936; 2352<3136; 3072<4624), with arrivals t(k,k,k)=5,8,11,14,17 and witnessing walks. Together with #6769 this pins the whole picture: the nu anisotropy reversal survives only at small k (body k<=2, face k<=3) and fails monotonically beyond, so it is a lattice-scale effect with no large-distance persistence.
verdict_pair: body reverse by k: YES k=1,2; NO k=3,4,5
